Energy infrastructure has been repeatedly targeted by both Ukraine and Russia , despite US President Donald Trump saying both sides had agreed to stop . Ukraine's repeated targeting of oil refineries has led to oil product shortages and fuel price increases in Russia. Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the strike had "a very significant impact," saying the oil in the hit refinery funds "billions of dollars to sustain the war machine." "Moscow must end its brutal war and choose peace instead of building layered rings of air defense at the expense of other regions," Zelenskyy posted on X.
